svg.title: Figure 3-2. Technical safety architecture of LD-SDA (WP-S-03 §3.2)
svg.desc: The comma device E-04 is split into a QM partition and the ASIL C safety envelope. The QM partition holds the E-04b cameras, IMU, display and speaker and the E-01 SoC processes: modeld and the DM model (E-02), locationd and calibration, radard, plannerd, controlsd, card, dmonitoringd, selfdrived, ui and soundd, and pandad. pandad talks to the safety MCU over SPI (IF-04) and the SoC drives the MCU boot and reset pins (IF-04b). In the MCU, comms_control_handler and comms_can_write (E-03b) feed the tick and heartbeat and the E-03a safety layer: safety_tx_hook with limits and gating, safety_rx_hook and the forwarding hook, which use FDCAN TX and RX. Bus 0 (IF-01, IF-02) goes through the E-05 harness relay to the vehicle CAN with EPS, PCM, ABS and cluster; bus 2 (IF-03) goes to the Toyota forward camera; the relay is driven by a GPIO (IF-10) and, when released, links camera and vehicle directly. The MCU siren and the SoC HMI warn the driver (IF-07). Each block carries the safety mechanisms (SM) and TSRs that §3.3, §5 and §6 assign to it.
